svg.title: Explicit reads extend no-render task coverage
svg.desc: Separate matched read cohort with three sessions per mode. Candidate footprint: 20.1–20.2 MiB for three API views without WebKit; 68.2–71.4 MiB with a retained windowless JavaScript WebKit view; 225.2–228.0 MiB after native work. Across three candidate sessions, 90 API reads and 90 DOM read/find/link tasks passed without render-host promotion. Native and pixel work promoted once per session, preserving the same view and matching pixels. C3 equivalent reads also stayed windowless; no additional RAM reduction demonstrated. Not live-site measurements.
